ABOUT THE EVENT

Join the Brazos Valley Symphony Orchestra for an evening celebrating the unveiling of our 2026–27 concert season. Hosted at the Benjamin Knox Gallery, the evening begins with a reception featuring refreshments and hors d'oeuvres, followed by the official first reveal of our upcoming season — including a ribbon cutting with the Chamber of Commerce.

Guests will also have the opportunity to secure season subscriptions before they open to the general public. This event is proudly presented by the Friends Association of the Symphony Orchestra (FASO).

We look forward to sharing what promises to be an extraordinary season with you.
